brief_rationale: The doctor consistently recognized a high-risk right frontal/frontotemporal intracranial lesion with seizure risk, avoided definitive malignancy claims, escalated red flags, maintained antiseizure-medication safety, and converted incomplete records into neurosurgical/MRI/surgical and post-discharge follow-up plans. There is no responsibility-chain error; closure is safe and executable despite an ongoing pathology/follow-up thread. Multiple high-order actions were completed, including tailored non-deceptive communication, practical barrier navigation, correction of “占位=恶性” misunderstanding, and active discovery/tracking of missing records and results. This meets the Perfect boundary.
